  as.numeric(x >= 0)
}

heaviside(z_val)

}

```{r}
#Q17
library(readr)
library(caret)
library(neuralnet)
pima=read_csv("pimaDiabetes.csv")
str(pima)
```

```{r}

set.seed(1)
y=factor(pima$testDiabetes, levels=c(0,1))
pima$testDiabetes=factor(pima$testDiabetes, levels=c(0,1))
inds=createDataPartition(
  y,
  times = 1,
  p = 0.8,
  list = TRUE,
  groups = min(5, length(y))
)

nrow(pima)*0.8;length(inds[['Resample1']])
#nrow(pima)*0.2;length(inds[['Resample2']])


training=pima[inds[['Resample1']],]
test=pima[-inds[['Resample1']],]


scale_training=data.frame(scale(data.matrix(training[,-ncol(training)]), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
scale_training$testDiabetes =training$testDiabetes

train_center <- vapply(training[,-ncol(training)], mean, numeric(1))
train_scale <- vapply(training[,-ncol(training)], sd, numeric(1))

scale_test=data.frame(scale(data.matrix(test[,-ncol(test)]), center = train_center, scale = train_scale))
scale_test$testDiabetes =test$testDiabetes

```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
pima_nn <- neuralnet(
 testDiabetes ~ .,
  data = scale_training,
  hidden = c(3),
  err.fct='ce',
  act.fct = "logistic",
  linear.output = FALSE
)


str(pima)
```

```{r}
library(caret)
library(neuralnet)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(1)

# Create folds
folds <- createFolds(training$testDiabetes, k = 10)

# Scaling helper function
scale_helper <- function(train, test,
                         target = "testDiabetes") {

  # Remove target column
  train_subset <- subset(
    train,
    select = -which(names(train) == target)
  )

  # Compute scaling parameters from training data
  tr_center <- vapply(train_subset,
                      mean,
                      numeric(1))

  tr_scale <- vapply(train_subset,
                     sd,
                     numeric(1))

  # Scale training data
  train_st <- as.data.frame(
    scale(
      data.matrix(train_subset),
      center = tr_center,
      scale = tr_scale
    )
  )

  train_st[[target]] <- train[[target]]

  # Remove target column from test data
  test_subset <- subset(
    test,
    select = -which(names(test) == target)
  )

  # Scale test data using TRAIN scaling parameters
  test_st <- as.data.frame(
    scale(
      data.matrix(test_subset),
      center = tr_center,
      scale = tr_scale
    )
  )

  test_st[[target]] <- test[[target]]

  return(list(
    train = train_st,
    test = test_st
  ))
}

# Cross-validation
cv_accuracy <- vapply(folds, function(fold) {

  # Split + scale
  scaled <- scale_helper(
    training[-fold, ],
    training[fold, ]
  )

  # Fit neural network
  fit <- neuralnet(
    testDiabetes ~ .,
    data = scaled$train,
    hidden = c(1),   # Change architecture here
    act.fct = "logistic",
    err.fct = "ce",
    linear.output = FALSE
  )

  # Predict probabilities
  test_pred <- predict(fit, scaled$test)

  # Convert predictions to dataframe
  test_pred_df <- data.frame(test_pred)

  # Rename probability columns
  colnames(test_pred_df) <- c(
    "prob_no",
    "prob_yes"
  )

  # Create predicted labels
  test_pred_df <- test_pred_df %>%
    mutate(
      pred_label =
        if_else(prob_yes >= 0.5, 1, 0)
    )

  # Add actual labels
  test_pred_df$testDiabetes <-
    scaled$test$testDiabetes

  # Compute accuracy
  corr_rate <- mean(
    test_pred_df$testDiabetes ==
      test_pred_df$pred_label
  )

  return(corr_rate)

}, numeric(1))

# Mean CV accuracy
mean(cv_accuracy)
```
